name: this coffin isn't big enough for the two of us
source:
Two assassins from enemy organizations wake up in a coffin together. If these two happen to engage in "intimacy" every once in a while... well, that's not anyone's business, is it?

[From [url=https://plagueofcrows.itch.io/coffin-isnt-big-enough]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
两名敌对组织的刺客在棺材里一起醒来。如果这两个人偶尔“亲密”一下……好吧，那不关任何人的事，不是吗？

[来自[url=https://plagueofcrows.itch.io/coffin-isnt-big-enough]itch.io[/url]]
